actions.reason: The K6_C0001-K6_C0004 boundary is weak and conflicting. Boundary representation is essentially absent in three of four native geometries (CT silhouette 0.029, RNA 0.023, WSI 0.001, with negative fractions 0.36/0.33/0.42), with only a single modest WXS signal (0.251). Boundary structure is likewise conflicting: although the current two-way assignment is represented (within 0.429 vs between 0.226, ARI 0.889), the normalized-cut cost is high (0.720) indicating substantial cross-boundary connectivity, and the union eigengap is dominated by the single-cluster resolution (candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.637 vs next 0.128), which is merge-compatible. Taken jointly, the weak/absent cross-modal boundary representation and single-cluster-dominated union support revising A|B to A∪B as a single unit.

merge_plans.rationale: Router authorized merging K6_C0001 and K6_C0004. The high normalized-cut cost (0.720) further indicates substantial cross-boundary connectivity. This revision is provisional and returns to normal review.

revision_plan.rationale: Executing the Router's authorized merge of K6_C0001 and K6_C0004 as a single unit, using only the structural diagnostics metric refs relevant to this pair boundary and union structure.

actions.reason: K6_C0002 has interpretable biology (immune/interferon and IL6-JAK-STAT3 down-regulation with OXPHOS/fatty-acid up-regulation, and multiplicity-robust VHL depletion), but its exact-set membership is broadly unsupported: all four native geometries show negative mean silhouettes (CT -0.162, WSI -0.183, RNA -0.041, WXS -0.023) with high negative fractions, and the nearest competing sets are K6_C0003 (CT/WSI), K6_C0005 (RNA), and K6_C0001_M_K6_C0004 (WXS). Its decision-relevant boundaries are weak or merge-compatible: K6_C0002 vs K6_C0003 shows weak native separation (silhouettes 0.049-0.141, CT negative fraction 0.389) with a strongly single-cluster-dominated union (candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.600) and high normalized-cut cost (0.690); K6_C0002 vs K6_C0005 shows weak native separation (0.026-0.116, WSI negative fraction 0.375); and K6_C0002 vs K6_C0001_M_K6_C0004 shows only modest separation (0.062-0.237) with substantial negative fractions. No supported split or merge alternative rescues it, and no remaining decision-relevant evidence could change this conclusion.

K6_C0003 has an interpretable inflammatory transcriptomic phenotype (interferon-alpha/gamma, allograft-rejection, TNFA/NFKB up-regulation), but its membership is not coherently represented: CT (0.148) and WSI (0.165) are modestly positive while RNA (-0.053, 71.4% negative) and WXS (-0.135, 81.0% negative) are negative, and the mutation view provides no multiplicity-robust program. Its decision-relevant boundaries are weak or merge-compatible: K6_C0002 vs K6_C0003 shows weak native separation with a strongly single-cluster-dominated union (candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.600); K6_C0003 vs K6_C0005 shows weak-to-modest separation with material cross-modal disagreement (CT/WSI stronger, RNA/WXS weaker); and K6_C0001_M_K6_C0004 vs K6_C0003 shows weak separation (0.046-0.135, CT/RNA negative fraction 0.33). Candidate-specific technical associations (tissue source site V=0.546, slice thickness epsilon_squared=0.261, z spacing 0.265) remain plausible alternative explanations for membership. No supported split or merge alternative rescues it, and no remaining decision-relevant evidence could change this conclusion.

K6_C0005 has interpretable biology (inflammatory transcriptomic program and multiplicity-robust BAP1 enrichment), but its membership is not coherently represented: only RNA is modestly positive (0.120), CT is negligible (0.017), and WSI (-0.103) and WXS (-0.090) are negative with high negative fractions. Its decision-relevant boundaries are weak or merge-compatible: K6_C0005 vs K6_C0006 shows conflicting native views (WXS strong 0.432, CT/RNA/WSI weak, WSI negative fraction 0.452); K6_C0002 vs K6_C0005 shows weak separation (0.026-0.116, WSI negative fraction 0.375); and K6_C0003 vs K6_C0005 shows weak-to-modest separation with material cross-modal disagreement. Candidate-specific technical associations (tissue source site V=0.414, z spacing epsilon_squared=0.0767, slice thickness 0.0517) remain plausible alternative explanations for membership. No supported split or merge alternative rescues it, and no remaining decision-relevant evidence could change this conclusion.

K6_C0006 has interpretable biology (mesenchymal/stromal-up, OXPHOS-down transcriptomic program and driver-panel VHL enrichment with PBRM1 depletion), but its membership representation is extremely discordant: WXS shows maximal separation (silhouette 1.0, within distance 0.0, a degenerate within-set geometry) while CT (-0.109), RNA (-0.064), and WSI (-0.129) are all negative with high negative fractions (85.7-92.9%). Its decision-relevant boundaries are weak or conflicting: K6_C0005 vs K6_C0006 shows conflicting native views (WXS strong, CT/RNA/WSI weak, WSI negative fraction 0.452); K6_C0001_M_K6_C0004 vs K6_C0006 shows material discordance (WXS moderate 0.332, CT essentially null -0.013 with negative fraction 0.62, RNA/WSI weak). No supported split or merge alternative rescues it, and no remaining decision-relevant evidence could change this conclusion.

K6_C0001_M_K6_C0004 has interpretable biology (OXPHOS/interferon/IL6-JAK-STAT3/complement down-regulation with TGF-beta/angiogenesis/Notch up-regulation, and multiplicity-robust PBRM1 enrichment), but its exact-set membership is not coherently represented: CT is clearly negative (silhouette -0.093, 97.2% negative fraction), RNA is essentially null (-0.006, 52.8% negative), WSI is negligible (0.015, 41.7% negative), and only WXS shows weak positive separation (0.049). Its decision-relevant boundaries are weak or merge-compatible: vs K6_C0002 modest separation (0.062-0.237) with a single-cluster-dominated union (candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.389); vs K6_C0003 weak separation (0.046-0.135, CT/RNA negative fraction 0.33) with a single-cluster-dominated union (candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.376); and vs K6_C0006 material discordance (WXS moderate, CT null with negative fraction 0.62). Candidate-specific technical associations (tissue source site V=0.425, CT manufacturer V=0.363, CT phase V=0.314, reconstruction kernel V=0.293, scanner model V=0.309, slice thickness epsilon_squared=0.0718, z spacing 0.0690) remain plausible alternative explanations for membership.
